[b]The United Republics 2025 Census Report[/b]

The United Republics Census Department has conducted the yearly census report on the population, current land area, and economy of the nation. The United Republics has grown slightly with the referendums in Northern Voloshensk and Souther Jandonia resulting in overwhelming support from local populations to join UREV. The economy has also grown with the increase of the population of the nation as well as the increase in global trade and agreements of the nations in Erene. 

The population now stands at 126,550,000 million people. 

15,795,400 million people live within South Vepsuria, in the Republics of North and South Jandonia. South Jandonia received expansions as the referendums that had taken place back in 2023 had voted 86% to join UREV, and recently the region was moved from a provisional state to being a part of South Jandonia. North Jandonia also received land expansions as the provisional government established following the region's decision to join UREV has successfully integrated the region into the United Republics. Currently 8,657,000 million people live in the Republic of North Jandonia, while 7,138,400 million people live in the Republic of South Jandonia.

45,354,500 million people live within North Vespuria. 4,428,995 million people live in the Republic of Greenvalley. 4,935,450 million people live in the Republic of Baliwick. 21,690,160 million people live in the Republic of Eden. 9,845,080 million people live in the Republic of Haven. 5,454,815 million people live in the Republic of Karos, which gained land to the east alongside a small island.

62,400,100 million people live in Elseyr. 16,213,000 million people live in the Destiny Capital District. 26,057,292 live in the Republic of Rostoria. 1,927,484 million people live in the Republic of Northwich. 3,373,097 million people live in the Republic of Ostermeer. 12,010,517 million people live in the Republic of Vostriya, which saw land expansion to the west alongside being handed over Pakarn Island which was previously administered by the Republic of Rostoria. 4,818,710 million people live in the Republic of Voloshensk, which saw land expansion to the north which is a region dominated by sparse forests and rural towns.

The GDP currently stands at 6.7 trillion, with a GDP per Capita of 52,943. 2% of the GDP is located in North Jandonia and 2% located in South Jandonia. 4% of the GDP is located in Greenvalley, another 3% is located in Baliwick, 22% is located in Eden, 9% is located in Haven, and 4% is located in Karos. 13% of the GDP is located in Destiny, 22% located in Rostoria, 3% located in Northwich, 4% located in Ostermeer, 9% located on Vostriya, 3% located on Voloshensk.
